decisions.reason: Using the client's manufacturing account to add boards does not change the required contents of the power-board production package.
The account-access and board-addition workflow does not alter the required sensor-board BOM or manufacturing exports.
Account access may facilitate the review, but the source does not change the requirement to check component orientations in the manufacturing platform.
The manufacturing-account setup method does not change any component availability or sourceability constraint.
Adding boards to the client's manufacturing account does not change the required board or connector-pin markings.
The account and cart setup decision has no effect on the power-board battery connector or electrical interface.
The manufacturing-account access workflow does not modify the main-board mechanical layout.
The source decision does not change ESP32-S3 pin access, breakout construction, or pin count.
The account-access method is unrelated to the main-board panel controls, connectors, and GPIO mappings.
The manufacturing setup workflow does not affect the board's electrical power-source OR-ing method.
The source decision does not alter the battery NTC temperature-monitoring behavior.
Adding boards through the client's manufacturing account does not change the power-board dimensions, orientation, placement, or connector-access constraints.
